# Major Donor Stewardship Plan

## Overview
A comprehensive approach to building lasting relationships with major donors through personalized engagement, recognition, and communication.

---

## 1. DONOR SEGMENTATION

### Tier Definitions
- **Tier 1**: $100,000+ annually
- **Tier 2**: $50,000-$99,999 annually
- **Tier 3**: $25,000-$49,999 annually
- **Tier 4**: $10,000-$24,999 annually

*(Adjust thresholds based on your organization's size)*

---

## 2. STEWARDSHIP TIMELINE

### Within 48 Hours of Gift
- Personalized thank-you call from appropriate staff/board member
- Hand-written thank-you note from ED/President
- Email acknowledgment with tax receipt

### Within 1 Week
- Formal gift acknowledgment letter
- Recognition preferences confirmed

### Within 1 Month
- Impact story or update related to their giving area
- Social media recognition (if approved)

### Ongoing (Quarterly)
- Personal updates from leadership
- Impact reports with metrics
- Invitation to exclusive briefings/events

---

## 3. PERSONALIZED ENGAGEMENT STRATEGIES

### Tier 1 ($100K+)
- **Touchpoints**: 12-15 annually
- Quarterly in-person meetings with CEO/Board Chair
- Private impact briefings
- Site visits and behind-the-scenes access
- Annual strategy session to discuss priorities
- Named recognition opportunities
- First access to special initiatives

### Tier 2 ($50K-$99K)
- **Touchpoints**: 8-10 annually
- Semi-annual meetings with senior leadership
- VIP event invitations
- Detailed impact reports
- Program-specific updates
- Recognition in annual report

### Tier 3 ($25K-$49K)
- **Touchpoints**: 6-8 annually
- Annual in-person meeting
- Special event invitations
- Quarterly impact updates
- Recognition opportunities

### Tier 4 ($10K-$24K)
- **Touchpoints**: 4-6 annually
- Personalized communications from development team
- Event invitations
- Semi-annual updates
- Listing in donor recognition materials

---

## 4. COMMUNICATION CALENDAR

### Monthly
- Personal email from relationship manager (Tiers 1-2)
- Impact story or news update

### Quarterly
- Comprehensive impact report
- Financial updates/dashboard
- Video message from leadership (Tiers 1-3)

### Semi-Annually
- In-person visit or phone call
- Exclusive donor briefing event

### Annually
- Annual report with personalized note
- Year-in-review meeting
- Strategic planning preview (Tiers 1-2)

---

## 5. RECOGNITION PROGRAM

### Public Recognition (with permission)
- Donor wall/honor roll
- Annual report listing
- Website acknowledgment
- Social media features
- Event programs
- Naming opportunities

### Private Recognition
- Personal letters from beneficiaries
- Board resolutions of appreciation
- Custom impact reports
- Exclusive briefings
- Advisory roles

---

## 6. ENGAGEMENT ACTIVITIES

### Exclusive Events
- **Tier 1**: Private dinners, VIP receptions, strategy sessions
- **Tier 2**: Small group dinners, program showcases
- **Tier 3-4**: Donor appreciation events, annual galas

### Meaningful Involvement
- Site visits and program observations
- Meet beneficiaries/program participants
- Advisory committee participation
- Volunteer opportunities
- Peer-to-peer engagement

### Educational Opportunities
- Issue briefings with experts
- Research findings presentations
- Trend analysis discussions
- Sector leadership forums

---

## 7. RELATIONSHIP MANAGEMENT

### Portfolio Assignments
- **CEO/Executive Director**: Tier 1 donors (8-12 donors)
- **Chief Development Officer**: Tier 1-2 donors (20-30 donors)
- **Major Gift Officers**: Tier 2-4 donors (75-100 donors each)
- **Board Members**: Strategic assignments across all tiers

### Documentation Requirements
- Contact reports within 24 hours
- CRM updates after every interaction
- Quarterly portfolio reviews
- Annual strategy sessions per donor

---

## 8. IMPACT REPORTING

### Metrics to Share
- People served/lives changed
- Geographic reach
- Program outcomes
- Financial efficiency
- Strategic progress
- Future goals

### Reporting Formats
- **Tier 1**: Custom dashboards, personalized videos, in-person briefings
- **Tier 2**: Detailed written reports, infographics, video updates
- **Tier 3-4**: Impact newsletters, annual reports, stories

---

## 9. RETENTION STRATEGIES

### Renewal Cultivation (6 months before ask)
- Review previous year's impact
- Schedule relationship-building meetings
- Invite to relevant events
- Provide insider updates
- Explore expanding interests

### At-Risk Donor Intervention
- Personal outreach from leadership
- Understanding changing circumstances
- Offering alternative involvement
- Demonstrating impact and need
- Creating meaningful touchpoints

---

## 10. STEWARDSHIP METRICS

### Track These KPIs
- Donor retention rate by tier
- Average gift increase year-over-year
- Number of touchpoints per donor
- Event attendance rates
- Upgrade/downgrade ratios
- Lifetime value trends
- Survey satisfaction scores

### Annual Assessment
- Portfolio performance review
- Relationship strength evaluation
- Communication effectiveness
- ROI analysis
- Donor feedback integration

---

## 11. GIFT ACKNOWLEDGMENT MATRIX

| Gift Amount | Thank You Call | Written Note | Letter | Board Contact | Special Recognition |
|-------------|---------------|--------------|--------|---------------|---------------------|
| $10K-$24K   | Development   | Gift Officer | Yes    | Optional      | Annual Report       |
| $25K-$49K   | CDO           | ED           | Yes    | Yes           | + Website           |
| $50K-$99K   | ED            | ED + Board   | Yes    | Yes           | + Donor Wall        |
| $100K+      | ED + Board    | Multiple     | Yes    | Yes           | + Custom Options    |

---

## 12. SAMPLE ANNUAL TOUCHPOINT PLAN (Tier 1)

**January**: New Year letter from ED with priorities  
**February**: Impact report from program staff  
**March**: Invitation to spring donor briefing  
**April**: Quarterly check-in call  
**May**: Site visit opportunity  
**June**: Mid-year impact report  
**July**: Personal note with success story  
**August**: One-on-one strategy meeting  
**September**: Invitation to fall event  
**October**: Program update video  
**November**: Renewal cultivation meeting  
**December**: Holiday greeting + annual report preview  

Plus: Birthday card, relevant news updates, spontaneous thank-yous

---

## Implementation Checklist

- [ ] Define donor tiers for your organization
- [ ] Assign portfolio responsibilities
- [ ] Create communication templates
- [ ] Develop impact reporting systems
- [ ] Schedule quarterly stewardship reviews
- [ ] Train staff on stewardship standards
- [ ] Set up CRM tracking systems
- [ ] Create recognition guidelines
- [ ] Establish feedback mechanisms
- [ ] Budget for stewardship activities

---

**Remember**: Effective stewardship is about building authentic relationships, not just securing the next gift. Focus on the donor's interests, communicate impact clearly, and always express genuine gratitude.
